title: FireClient early access is live, full version planned for November 2026
excerpt: Early access is open for Windows. Here is what works today, what is still planned, and what we know about the full version.

title: How much RAM should you give Minecraft? A practical guide
excerpt: Starting points for Minecraft memory, why more is not always better, and where to set it in the FireClient launcher.

title: Back up and reuse your FireClient HUD layout
excerpt: Your HUD layout lives in one small file. Copy it to keep a backup or to move your setup to another PC.

title: How to set up the FireClient HUD in Minecraft 1.21.1
excerpt: Open the FireClient menu with Right Shift, switch on the HUD elements you want and drag them into place with the HUD editor.

title: Install FireClient on Windows in five steps
excerpt: Download the installer, check its SHA-256, run it, sign in and launch Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric to get the in-game menu.

title: FireClient 1.0 is available as a free Windows beta
excerpt: The launcher and the Fabric in-game client for Minecraft 1.21.1 are free to download for Windows 10 and 11.
